## 01 – Alert Intake (owner: Vishwa)
Alertmanager → validate → de-duplicate → respond 202 → create incident via `POST /api/machine/incidents` (**BD-1**, idempotent on the alert fingerprint) → run 05 Root Cause for every new alert.
Auth: Header Auth credential "Alertmanager Webhook Token" (Alertmanager sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

nodes.name: Parse and validate alerts
nodes.notes: Firing alerts only; resolved alerts are acknowledged.

nodes.name: Detect duplicate alerts
nodes.notes: fingerprint + startsAt, kept DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES (static data; production executions only).

nodes.name: Accepted response
nodes.notes: Adds the HTTP status for the response.

nodes.name: Respond 202
nodes.notes: Answers Alertmanager before the long investigation starts.

nodes.name: Sign create incident request
nodes.notes: One signed request per new alert (BD-1).

nodes.name: Backend: create incident
nodes.notes: POST /api/machine/incidents (BD-1) → create_incident_from_alert; 201 created / 200 existing { incident_id, investigation_id, created }.

nodes.name: Incident result
nodes.notes: created → 05 stores the analysis; failed → alert released for the next delivery (N-3).

nodes.name: Confirm alert processing
nodes.notes: N-3: created/blocked → confirmed; failed → released (the next delivery is processed again).

nodes.name: Run 05 Root Cause
nodes.notes: One sub-workflow run per new alert.

nodes.name: Soft failure?
nodes.notes: Set by the nodes before: completion failed after retries, start unconfirmed, AI unavailable, result not stored.

nodes.name: Report soft failure
nodes.notes: One redacted notification per kind of failure (no request data).

nodes.name: Notify error handler (09)
nodes.notes: Runs 09 ("When called with a soft failure"): Slack/Discord when ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL is set.
